items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower As Analysts Split On Broadband Outlook
items.summary: The price target narrative for Charter Communications has shifted, with fair value estimates moving from US$169.00 to about US$157.22 as analysts reassess the stock. That change sits alongside a wide spread of opinions, from Underperform to Buy, and reflects debate over how cost savings, broadband trends and the mobile business might shape long term returns on capital. In the sections that follow, you will see how this evolving analyst story fits together and how to track it over...

items.title: Why Charter Communications Stock Is Back In Focus After $2 Billion Cost Saving Plan
items.summary: Charter Communications recently reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$14.922b alongside a shareholder loss of US$2.397b that was mainly driven by a US$6.326b non cash franchise impairment, while also outlining an Internet first operating model and integration progress following the Cox Communications acquisition. The company is targeting US$2b in annualized operating expense reductions over 18 months, on top of planned Cox related synergies, signalling a sharp focus on cost discipline...

items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Jumps After Cox Deal, Is It Still Cheap?
items.summary: Why Charter Communications Is Back On Radar After Q3 And Cox Deal Charter Communications (CHTR) is back in focus after an over 8% single day move, fueled by fresh reactions to its recent Cox Communications acquisition and mixed third quarter update.
